name: City
description: Recipe: city grid (streets, buildings, optional pyramid or empty center plaza, lights, vehicles). Pass catalog to derive buildings, vehicles, traffic lights, billboards.

inputs.name: catalog
inputs.description: Full block catalog; recipe parses to buildings, vehicles, traffic lights

inputs.name: noPyramid
inputs.description: Omit pyramid; reserve the geometric center block as empty plaza (no buildings)

inputs.name: pyramid
inputs.description: Alias: false / none / off (with noPyramid) omits pyramid; center stays empty

inputs.name: windowColors
inputs.description: Hex palette for emissive window cubes on Building2 (e.g. ["#00aaff","#ff6600"])

inputs.name: billboardCatalogIds
inputs.description: Billboard catalog IDs; if omitted, derived from catalog entries tagged billboard

inputs.name: buildings
inputs.description: Building pool (id, name, url, width, depth, height)
